body:
Harper (PM): Notes from lunchtime playtest. Users tripped on three things: 1) burst label ambiguity, 2) min/max visibility in compact lists, 3) slider announcements not including cost. Quick fixes only.

Noel (Design): Agreed. Tiny rules: keep '+burst' badge in lists, full copy 'Burst capacity (temporary)' in detail. In compact rows hide min/max, surface them in an expandable capacity row.

Riya (Eng): Backend support: can add `burst_available` and `burst_note` fields. Also can return `preview_cost_cents` for selection previews. API: GET /pools?compact=true&include_preview=true.

Oli (Frontend): Keyboarding bug: when capacity row expands focus sometimes moves to first control inside and arrow keys no longer navigate results. I'll implement `role="listbox"` + `aria-activedescendant` and keep arrow handling at the list level.

Zara (A11y): Announcements: slider changes need `aria-live="polite"` with plain sentences: 'Target latency 140 milliseconds. Estimated throughput 38 Q.P.S. Estimated cost nine dollars per day.' Tooltips must have accessible names.

Noel (Design): Copy for caps: show small pill text under numbers: 'Hard limit' vs 'Recommended cap'. Use border styles not color alone.

Riya (Eng): We'll add `cap_type` enum to pool objects. No perf impact. Also can emit `recommendation_age_s` so UI can choose dotted vs solid badge for new recs.

Oli (Frontend): For compact view propose micro-copy inline: 'Est: +4 qps · +$0.40/hr'. On hover expand to 'Estimated impact: +$0.40/hr (+$9/day)'. Toast with Undo for min/max changes (10s timeout).

Zara (A11y): Toasts must be `role=status` and include keyboard-focusable Undo. Also ensure currency is spoken naturally (e.g., 'nine dollars per day').

Harper (PM): Decision log: keep '+burst' badge, add `burst_note` tooltip, hide min/max in compact list, add expandable capacity row, announce slider with cost and qps, toast undo for 10s.

Riya (Eng): Action items: add fields `burst_available,burst_note,cap_type,preview_cost_cents,recommendation_age_s` to search/preview endpoints. We'll also return `slo_samples` (5 points) when requested.

Noel (Design): I'll update mocks: compact + expanded states, pill styles, microcopy for toast and hover expansion.

Oli (Frontend): I'll fix keyboard flow, `aria-activedescendant`, implement live region text, and toast/undo (shortcut 'u').

Zara (A11y): I'll run a quick screenreader pass on the new live text and the toast. Note: slider should set `aria-valuetext` e.g., '120 milliseconds, near recommended'.

build-bot: Preview for branch `fix/compact-autoscale-a11y` at https://deploy.preview/fix/compact-autoscale-a11y (auto). :shipit:
file_name_note: Timestamp+description format. Single-thread content string per agents.md requirements.
